# Paths published to the public template repo.
#
# DENY BY DEFAULT. Nothing leaves this repo unless it is listed here. Adding a
# line is a publishing decision — it makes that path, and every future change to
# it, public forever. Removing a line stops future syncs but does NOT unpublish
# what already went out.
#
# Syntax: one path per line, relative to the repo root.
#   - a file            -> published as that file
#   - a directory/      -> published recursively
#   - blank / #comment  -> ignored
# Globs are NOT expanded here: name a file or a directory. This is deliberate —
# `lib/*.ts` would silently pick up whatever lands in lib/ next month.
#
# Every path is additionally re-scanned by .github/scripts/build-template.sh
# before publish. The allowlist decides intent; the scanner is the backstop.
#
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Nothing from the app's build config is published.
#
# tsconfig.json, next.config.mjs and .gitignore were listed here at first and
# then removed: they are app-specific, not library-specific. next.config.mjs
# describes resume-upload body limits and OG-image font tracing; .gitignore
# names internal conventions. None of it is sensitive, none of it helps someone
# adopting two files, and all of it describes a codebase the reader cannot see.
# The template's own scaffolding lives in .github/template-overlay/ instead.
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# The AI infrastructure layer — the genuinely reusable part.
#
# These two carry no business content: response.ts is usage logging plus the
# stop_reason guards, cache.ts is prompt-cache breakpoint placement. They are
# the pieces another team would actually want.
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
lib/ai/response.ts
lib/ai/cache.ts

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# NOT published, and why — so the reasoning survives the next person to edit
# this file. Do not uncomment without deciding deliberately.
#
# scripts/                  Import/backup scripts carry production records,
#                           including named-employee coaching content.
# supabase/migrations/      Publishes the full internal schema, including the
#                           candidate_sensitive / compensation_sensitive shape.
# app/admin/, app/private/  Internal operations surfaces and per-client pages.
# app/proposals/            Named client commercial material.
# lib/coaching/, lib/ats/   Business logic over personal data.
# lib/admin-chat/,          System prompts + tool schemas for the DB agents.
#   lib/team-chat/          Publishing these hands an attacker the injection map.
# lib/ai/brand-writer.ts,   Reusable in shape, but the system prompts encode the
#   campaign-seo.ts,        house methodology. Business IP, not a secret —
#   entry-copy.ts,          publish only if you actively want to give it away.
#   coaching/ai.ts
# .github/                  Workflows carry secret names and the sync topology.
# package.json,             Dependency list is fine, but the file also names
#   package-lock.json       private scripts; publish a template-authored one via
#                           the overlay instead.
# vercel.json               Cron topology + client redirect history.
